RAJYA  SABHA
————
List of Questions for ORAL ANSWERS
to be asked at a sitting of the Rajya Sabha to be held on
Tuesday, November 27, 2012/Agrahayana 6, 1934 (Saka)
————
(Ministries : Civil Aviation; Environment and Forests; Health and Family
Welfare; Heavy Industries and Public Enterprises; Petroleum and Natural Gas;
Power; Road Transport and Highways; Shipping)
Total number of questions — 20
Diversion of AI Express flight
*61. SHRI M.P . ACHUTHAN: Will
the Minister of CIVIL A VIATION be
pleased to state:
(a) whether Government’s attention has
been drawn to an incident of diverting an
Air India Express flight from Abu Dhabi to
Thiruvananthapuram instead of landing in
Kochi and the agitated passengers
protesting, leading the pilot to trigger a
plane hijack alarm etc.;
(b) if so, the details thereof;
(c) whether any enquiry has been
conducted into the incident; and
(d) if so, the details and outcome
thereof ?
Steps taken for making the Y amuna
river pollution free
†*62. SHRI DARSHAN SINGH
YADA V: Will the Minister of
ENVIRONMENT AND FORESTS be
pleased to state:
(a) the allocation of funds made during
the last three years till date to make the
Yamuna river pollution free, year-wise;
(b) whether it is a fact that the Supreme
Court has issued instructions to
Government expressing concern over
pollution in the Yamuna river;
(c) if so, the details thereof;
(d) whether the Central Government
has taken any steps to clean the Yamuna
river as per the orders of the Supreme
Court; and
(e) if so, the details thereof along with
the achievements made in this regard?
Safety of tigers in the country
*63. SHRI D.P . TRIPATHI: Will the
Minister of ENVIRONMENT AND
FORESTS be pleased to state:
(a) whether it is a fact that the National
Tiger Conservative Authority (NTCA) has
failed in its mission;
†Original notice of the question received in Hindi.

20
(b)  if so, the reasons therefor; and
(c) the details of action Government is
taking for the safety of tigers in the country?
Development of ports under PPP mode
in country
*64. SHRI BHUPENDER YADAV:
Will the Minister of SHIPPING be pleased
to state:
(a) whether Government has undertaken
any study to determine the demand and
availability of port facilities in the coastal
States in the country;
(b) if so, the details thereof and the action
taken thereon;
(c) whether Government proposes to
develop new major and minor ports along
India’s coastline;
(d) if so, the details and the present
position thereof, State-wise;
(e) whether Government proposes to
develop some of these ports with private
participation under the Public-Private
Partnership (PPP) mode; and
(f) if so, the details thereof along with
the names of the ports being considered for
development under the PPP mode?
Access to quality palliative care
services
*65. DR. PRABHAKAR KORE: Will
the Minister of HEALTH AND FAMILY
WELFARE be pleased to state:
(a) whether it is a fact that less than 2
per cent of the country's population has
access to palliative care;
(b) if so, the response of Government
in this regard;
(c) whether Government is taking steps
to provide adequate facilities for access to
quality palliative care services;
(d) if so, the details thereof; and
(e) if not, the reasons therefor?
Consumption pattern of LPG
cylinders
*66. SHRI TAPAN KUMAR SEN:
Will the Minister of PETROLEUM AND
NATURAL GAS be pleased to state:
(a) whether it is a fact that the three
State-run LPG selling companies have
conducted a countrywide survey to assess
average annual consumption of cylinders
per connection; and
(b) if so, the details of the survey
conducted by the three companies ?
Door-to-door campaign for cancer
detection
*67. DR. JANARDHAN
WAGHMARE: Will the Minister of
HEALTH AND FAMILY WELFARE be
pleased to state:
(a) whether the deaths due to cancer are
increasing day by day in the country;
(b) if so, whether some State
Governments have started door-to-door
campaign for a symptom-based early
detection and awareness about cancer;
(c) if so, whether the Central
Government would extend special
assistance to such States and proposes to
issue guidelines to all the States to conduct
such campaigns to minimize cancer deaths;
and
(d) if so, the details thereof?

21
†Original notice of the question received in Hindi.
Construction of new international
airports in Uttar Pradesh
†*68. SHRI MOHAN SINGH: Will the
Minister of CIVIL A VIATION be pleased
to state:
(a) whether the Ministry has prepared
a plan to construct some new international
airports across the country;
(b) if so, the number of airports
proposed to be constructed; and
(c) the details of airports which are to
be expanded, renovated and upgraded to
the international standard in Uttar Pradesh?
Imposition of fine on RIL for shortfall
in gas production
*69. SHRI P. RAJEEVE: Will the
Minister of PETROLEUM AND
NATURAL GAS be pleased to state:
(a) whether any fine had been imposed
on the Reliance Industries Ltd. (RIL) due
to shortfall of production from the KG-D6
gas fields in 2011-12;
